simple.summary: בֵּית־גָּדֵר (Bêyth-Gâdêr) means Beth-Gader , a place in Palestine First listed occurrence: 1Chr 2 51.

definitions.full: H1013. Beth Gader גָּדֵר בֵּית proper name, of a location in Judah ( place of a wall ) 1Chr 2:51 (as proper name, masculine) ᵐ5 Βαιθγαιδων ᵐ5 L Βηθγεδδωρ ; = גֶּ֫דֶר Josh 12:13 ?, compare הַגְּדֵרִי 1Chr 27:28 , etc.
